content:
alice.k: Heads-up — after today's ruby gem bump (v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0) sampleapp tests show different retry behavior on 429/503 vs JS SDK. Steps below.

alice.k: Repro: run `bundle exec rspec spec/integration/retries_spec.rb` — ruby client returns 429 as final error, JS retries and succeeds.

ben: :eyes: can you paste the log snippet?

alice.k: ```
I, [2026-03-22T09:12:34.123Z]  INFO -- : request to /v1/generate returned 429
I, [2026-03-22T09:12:34.456Z]  INFO -- : ruby client: no retry configured for 429, bubbling error
I, [2026-03-22T09:12:35.001Z]  INFO -- : js client: retried (attempt 1) -> succeeded
```

carla: Most likely Faraday / retry middleware change. The 1.5.0 bump rearranged middleware to avoid double retries, we might've accidentally dropped the compat retry mapping.

sam: I skimmed the changelog — we removed the implicit `retry` middleware in favor of letting users opt-in. That explains it.

alice.k: Sampleapp uses default client config, so it's a breaking DX for users who relied on implicit 429->retry. Not an outage but surprising for new adopters.

ben: Proposal: reintroduce an explicit retry policy in ruby with the same semantics as JS (retry on 429 and all 5xx, jittered exponential backoff, max 3 attempts). Wrap it behind a short-lived feature flag `compat_parity_mode` default true for one release.

carla: Agreed. Also add an integration test that mocks a 429 then 200 to ensure parity. And note the behavior change in the release notes + sampleapp README.

sam: I'll open a small PR to add middleware + tests and the README note. @ben want to review?

ben: Yep, can review tonight. assign to me in PR.

ci-bot: CI failing on sampleapp job — https://ci.redwood.ai/1001/job/rspec — failing `spec/integration/retries_spec.rb` (ruby).

alice.k: Thanks. PR would unblock the sampleapp e2e tests. Also please add a one-line migration note for customers.

sam: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-client/pull/204 — includes compat middleware, tests, and README changelog.

ben: LGTM, left one small comment about test timing. :thumbsup:

carla: Ops okayed a micro-release for tomorrow in #eng-infra, so once PR merges we can publish patch.

alice.k: Perfect — will update the sampleapp README & notify dev-experiments channel after release.

sam: Merging after ben's tiny fix, will bump gem and publish to rubygems.

alice.k: Thanks everyone. We'll watch sampleapp and the onboarding tickets, ping here if we get new reports.
